result.summary: The viewer, identified by their royal blue shirt, operates primarily on the left wing despite being designated as a central attacker. There is a general lack of central attacking movement and support for the ball carrier throughout the clip.

observations.title: Initial central positioning
observations.body: The viewer is positioned centrally in the attacking half as their team (green) has possession on the left flank. They are ahead of the ball, but not making a specific run.

observations.title: No immediate defensive engagement
observations.body: When possession is lost by a teammate, the viewer does not immediately engage in a counter-press or track back to help win the ball. They continue moving forward for a moment before slowing.

observations.title: Drifting from central role
observations.body: As the opposing team (white) gains possession and builds play, the viewer drifts significantly from a central attacking position towards the left wing. This takes them out of a primary attacking channel.

observations.title: Lack of central support after regaining possession
observations.body: When the viewer's team (green) regains possession, the viewer remains wide on the left wing. They do not move back into a central position to offer a passing option or make a run as a central attacker.
